
### unfair dequeue/drop 


::: {.r-stack}
![](/queuing/texfig/fifo-unfair-dequeue.figure-1.svg){.fragment .fade-out fragment-index=2 width=800px}

![](/queuing/texfig/fifo-unfair-dequeue.figure-2.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2 width=800px}

![](/queuing/texfig/fifo-unfair-dequeue.figure-3.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=3 width=800px}

![](/queuing/texfig/fifo-unfair-dequeue.figure-4.svg){.fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=4 width=800px}

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=2}

*  intuitive notion of `fair' would mean:
   *  top flow gets 2.5 pkts/sec out
   *  bottom flow gets 2.5 pkts/sec out

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=3}

*  FIFO + drop tail does not distinguish flows
*  both flows will have same drop rate
   *  (assuming "random" arrivals)

:::

::: {.myoverbox .vlow .fragment .fade-in-then-out fragment-index=4}

*  same drop rate = preserve ratio of input demand
   *  far from even ("intuitive fair") spit

:::
